description.value: Nohra Thai Kitchen is a family-run Thai restaurant in Victoria's Estevan neighbourhood, owned and operated by Phen Bryan, who brings multiple generations of Thai culinary heritage to each dish. The kitchen emphasizes authenticity rooted in family recipes refined over decades, and the restaurant also hosts private functions and special chef's table events. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 30m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; rack at 36m; rack at 38m; rack at 68m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active Thai restaurant at 2524 Estevan Ave, Victoria, operated by chef Phen Bryan. Phone (250-595-7868), address, and website all match OSM tags exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; takeout is explicitly confirmed via the repeated 'Dine-In, Take-Out & Delivery' phrasing across all pages.
concerns: OSM alt_name is 'Nora Thai', which differs from the official name 'Nohra Thai Kitchen' used consistently on the website — may cause search confusion but is not a listing concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Thai restaurant with a live website and confirmed contact details. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in the Estevan neighbourhood of Victoria.
